name: barbell zercher carry
description: Carrying a barbell in the crooks of your elbows. It loads the legs, upper back and trunk in a tough front-loaded position.
instructions: Set the bar in your elbow crooks, hugging it tight to your chest.
Stand tall with your chest up and your abs braced.
Walk with controlled steps while keeping the bar close.
Cover the set distance without rounding forward.
Lower the bar to the rack or floor carefully.
